## Void Deck 0.2.17

**Your settings stick.** Skin, light theme and Home screen choices are remembered, so restarting Steam or Decky no longer switches them back on or back to dark.

**Battery and Wi-Fi meters recover.** The dot meters no longer stay away for the whole session when Steam is slow to publish its battery hooks.

**Quieter breakage.** When a Steam update removes a class Void Deck uses, the plugin log now names it instead of failing in silence.

**A smaller download.** The release ZIP no longer carries the development source map.

**Honest README.** The settings list no longer documents options that were removed.

**L1 goes Home.** The left bumper returns to Home, matching the right bumper.

**Install / update:** Decky → ⚙ → Developer → *Install Plugin from ZIP*, then select `VoidDeck-v0.2.17.zip` from this release.
